title: Line 408: broad `except Exception` (BLE001)
detail: Catching `Exception` at line 408 prevents distinguishing expected errors from unexpected failures. Fix: catch specific exception types, or re-raise after logging if a broad catch is intentional.

title: 4× broad `except Exception` (W0703) — lines 445, 453, 621, 744
detail: 4 broad `except Exception` clauses (first at line 445). Each swallows unexpected error types. Fix: catch specific exceptions at each site.
